scope: 35 file-session controls and three temporary fixture controls; no complete-auth, malicious filesystem race, native ACL or whole-disk-lifecycle claim.

resolved.issue: Read failure removed a valid persistent session
resolved.correction: Preserve the file and propagate exact non-parse failure.

resolved.issue: Failed write could leave cache and persistent session divergent
resolved.correction: Exclusive staged file is written/flushed/closed/published before Map publication; compound recovery failure quarantines the repository.

resolved.issue: Storage capability could access non-child paths or linked leaves
resolved.correction: Capture own filesystem ports and enforce direct-child regular leaf scope before effects.

resolved.issue: Foreign or quarantined replacement repository could be reused
resolved.correction: Private current-repository brand and healthy-state admission before handoff; no foreign callback invocation.

resolved.issue: Two source tests retained temporary directory trees
resolved.correction: Owned fixture normal-completion hooks and non-traversing junction cleanup; old unowned directories remain untouched.
